Muller in 1956, is a well known Monte Carlo method that leverages Brownian exit distributions from spheres to solve the Laplace equation with Dirichlet boundary conditions. Its mesh-free nature, robustness on complex geometries, favorable scaling with dimension, and intrinsic parallelism distinguish it from mesh-based solvers. However, its efficient applicability has been essentially limited to operators that admit explicit probabilistic exit laws, excluding most variable-coefficient and nonlinear elliptic operators. We propose a general framework that aims to overcome this limitation by using the classical Dirichlet Laplacian and harmonic extension as universal building blocks. Rather than seeking a custom stochastic representation for each operator, we employ Walk-on-Spheres to precompute a reusable numerical operator toolbox that approximates the inverse Dirichlet Laplacian, the harmonic extension operator, and their gradients. These precomputed operators are then used to represent candidate solutions and to transform arbitrary Dirichlet boundary value problems into finite-dimensional algebraic system for an unknown source term. Solving the resulting algebraic system and substituting back yields an approximate solution to the original PDE. Even more, for a general linear second order elliptic operator, the above mentioned precomputed toolbox can be directly used to obtain not just an approximation of a certain solution of the corresponding generalized Dirichlet problem, but an estimator of both the Green's integral operator and the elliptic measure operator. Numerical experiments on a range of benchmarks, including non-symmetric and anisotropic linear elliptic equations, semilinear and quasilinear problems, demonstrate the method's flexibility and efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 用于散度型线性和非线性椭圆问题的扩展球上行走算法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种扩展的Walk-on-Spheres算法，利用预计算的算子工具箱成功将无网格蒙特卡洛方法推广至线性和非线性散度型椭圆偏微分方程的求解。
AI.motivation: 传统的Walk-on-Spheres算法的高效应用基本受限于具有显式概率出口律的算子，无法直接处理大多数变系数和非线性椭圆算子。为了克服这一局限性，需要开发一种通用的框架。
AI.method: 利用经典的狄利克雷拉普拉斯算子和调和延拓作为通用构建块，通过Walk-on-Spheres预计算可重用的数值算子工具箱（逼近逆狄利克雷拉普拉斯算子、调和延拓算子及其梯度），将任意狄利克雷边界值问题转化为未知源项的有限维代数系统。
AI.result: 数值实验涵盖了一系列基准测试（包括非对称和各向异性线性椭圆方程、半线性及拟线性问题），验证了该方法在处理复杂椭圆问题时的灵活性和高效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基于Walk-on-Spheres算法的通用框架，能够高效求解线性和非线性散度型椭圆问题，并通过数值实验验证了其灵活性与有效性。
AI.translation: 由M. E. Muller于1956年引入的球上行走（Walk-on-Spheres）算法是一种著名的蒙特卡洛方法，它利用球面上的布朗运动离开分布来求解具有狄利克雷边界条件的拉普拉斯方程。其无网格特性、在复杂几何形状上的鲁棒性、随维度变化的良好缩放性以及固有的并行性，使其区别于基于网格的求解器。然而，其高效应用基本局限于那些承认显式概率出口律的算子，这排除了大多数变系数和非线性椭圆算子。我们提出了一个通用框架，旨在通过使用经典的狄利克雷拉普拉斯算子和调和延拓作为通用构建块来克服这一局限。我们没有为每个算子寻求定制的随机表示，而是采用球上行走来预计算一个可重用的数值算子工具箱，该工具箱近似逆狄利克雷拉普拉斯算子、调和延拓算子及其梯度。然后，这些预计算的算子被用来表示候选解，并将任意狄利克雷边值问题转化为关于未知源项的有限维代数系统。求解得到的代数系统并代回，即可得到原PDE的近似解。不仅如此，对于一般的二阶线性椭圆算子，上述预计算的工具箱不仅可直接用于获得相应广义狄利克雷问题某个解的近似值，还可用于获得格林积分算子和椭圆测度算子的估计器。在一系列基准测试（包括非对称和各向异性线性椭圆方程、半线性及拟线性问题）上的数值实验证明了该方法的灵活性和效率。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种扩展的Walk-on-Spheres算法框架，用于求解线性和非线性散度型椭圆问题。通过使用预计算的数值算子工具箱代替定制的随机表示，该方法能够处理变系数和非线性偏微分方程，并在多类基准测试中展现出良好的灵活性与效率。
AI.keywords: Walk-on-Spheres, 蒙特卡洛方法, 椭圆型偏微分方程, 无网格求解器, 算子预计算
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将经典的球上行走（Walk-on-Spheres）算法推广应用到变系数和非线性椭圆型偏微分方程中，通过预计算通用的数值算子工具箱，巧妙绕过了传统蒙特卡洛方法对特定概率出口律的依赖。这为无网格蒙特卡洛求解复杂PDE开辟了新途径。

title: ReQuant: Fixed-Grid Discrete Refinement for Post-Training Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to reduce the memory and computational cost of large language models. Existing PTQ methods typically obtain an initial quantized model through heuristic rules or greedy optimization, and once quantization is completed the resulting integer assignments are usually treated as final. This observation motivates a complementary optimization stage within PTQ that keeps quantized weights improvable after an executable quantized model has been produced, while preserving the quantized format. We introduce ReQuant, a backpropagation-free fixed-grid refinement procedure for this stage. Agnostic to the PTQ initializer, ReQuant takes an existing quantized model as a feasible starting point and iteratively revisits its discrete weight assignments on the fixed quantization grid. Accepted updates strictly reduce the mean squared reconstruction error and remain on the original grid. In this way, ReQuant turns the initially fixed PTQ output into an iteratively optimizable discrete solution and serves as a plug-and-play post-processing stage for existing PTQ pipelines. Experiments across diverse model families, bit-widths, and downstream tasks show that ReQuant consistently improves quantized models from heterogeneous PTQ initializers, with especially large gains on simple initializers and lower bit-widths. Notably, ReQuant can refine a simple round-to-nearest initialization across multiple sweeps until it approaches or surpasses GPTAQ under the same quantization format. These results establish ReQuant as a practical complementary stage for further improving existing PTQ pipelines.

AI.title_translation: ReQuant：面向后训练量化的固定网格离散求精
AI.tldr: ReQuant 是一种针对大模型后训练量化的无需反向传播的固定网格离散求精方法，作为即插即用的后处理阶段可显著提升现有量化模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的后训练量化（PTQ）方法通常通过启发式规则或贪婪优化获得初始量化模型，一旦完成量化，整数分配通常被视为最终结果。这促使人们寻找一个互补的优化阶段，在保持量化格式的同时，使量化权重在生成可执行的量化模型后仍可得到持续改进。
AI.method: 引入了 ReQuant，一种无需反向传播的固定网格求精程序。它将现有的量化模型作为可行起点，在固定量化格点上迭代重访其离散权重分配，接受严格减小均方重建误差且保持在原网格上的更新。
AI.result: 跨不同模型系列、比特宽度和下游任务的实验表明，ReQuant 能够持续改善来自异构 PTQ 初始化器的量化模型，在简单的初始化器和较低比特宽度下增益尤为显著，甚至能使简单的四舍五入初始化接近或超过 GPTAQ 的效果。
AI.conclusion: ReQuant 是一种实用且通用的 PTQ 补充阶段，能够有效将现有的量化模型离散权重分配进行迭代优化，在多种模型、比特宽度和下游任务中均表现出显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 后训练量化（PTQ）被广泛用于减少大语言模型的内存和计算成本。现有的 PTQ 方法通常通过启发式规则或贪婪优化获得初始量化模型，一旦量化完成，所得到的整数分配通常被视为最终结果。这一观察促使我们在 PTQ 中引入一个互补的优化阶段：在生成可执行的量化模型后，使量化权重保持可改进状态，同时保留量化的格式。为此，我们介绍了 ReQuant，这是一个用于该阶段的、无需反向传播的固定网格求精程序。ReQuant 与 PTQ 初始化器无关，它将现有的量化模型作为可行的起点，并在固定的量化网格上迭代重访其离散权重分配。被接受的更新会严格减少均方重建误差，并保留在原始网格上。通过这种方式，ReQuant 将最初固定的 PTQ 输出转变为一个可迭代优化的离散解，并可作为现有 PTQ 流水线的即插即用后处理阶段。在不同的模型系列、比特宽度和下游任务上的实验表明，ReQuant 持续改善了来自异构 PTQ 初始化器的量化模型，在简单的初始化器和较低的比特宽度下获得了特别大的增益。值得注意的是，ReQuant 可以在多个扫描轮次中求精一个简单的“四舍五入到最近邻”初始化，直到它接近或超过相同量化格式下的 GPTAQ。这些结果确立了 ReQuant 作为进一步改善现有 PTQ 流水线的实用互补阶段的地位。
AI.summary: ReQuant 是一种针对大型语言模型后训练量化（PTQ）的固定网格离散求精方法。它作为一种无需反向传播、即插即用的后处理阶段，能够在保持原有量化格式的同时，通过迭代更新离散权重分配来持续降低均方重建误差，从而显著提升现有 PTQ 方法的量化性能。
AI.keywords: Post-Training Quantization, Large Language Models, Discrete Refinement, Fixed-Grid, Backpropagation-Free
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种无需反向传播的固定网格离散求精方法 ReQuant，作为后训练量化（PTQ）的后处理阶段。其创新之处在于能够将最初固定的量化输出转化为可迭代优化的离散解，且不改变原始量化格式。这为提升大语言模型量化性能提供了一条实用且通用的途径。

title: What Are Developers Actually Discussing When Visual Regression Tests Fail?
summary: Visual Regression Tests (VRTs) are widely adopted as a mechanism for detecting unintended visual changes in user interfaces. By design, VRTs operate on rendered pixel output, and the prevailing assumption is that they catch stylistic regressions such as layout shifts, color mismatches, and font alterations. We conduct an empirical analysis of 307 pull requests (PRs) from 103 GitHub repositories that incorporate VRT results via Chromatic, comparing them against 299 PRs that contain image attachments but no VRT (Visual PRs). Quantitatively, VRT-PRs show no significant acceptance-rate difference, but exhibit a 3.8 times longer median resolution time, 10 times more discussion comments, and 1.75 to 4.5 times larger code changes than Visual PRs. VRT results are typically shared around the midpoint of the review process, sustaining ongoing discussion rather than serving only as a final check. Through a card-sorting analysis of 189 VRT-flagged issues, we identify seven defect categories assigned to the analyzed issues: Layout (39.7\%), Appearance (27.5\%), Color (14.8\%), Text (9.5\%), State (6.9\%), Test (6.3\%), and Image (4.2\%). The three most frequent categories are stylistic, while approximately 18.5\% of analyzed issues (35/189) involve non-stylistic origins, including undefined component state (13 cases), content disappearance (17 cases across multiple categories), and visually imperceptible regressions (5 cases). We further document cases in which VRT detected visual regressions originating from code changes in seemingly unrelated files, exposing non-local effects that no targeted test would have been written to catch. These observations indicate that, in addition to its primary role as a stylistic checker, VRT functions as a secondary detector of unintended consequences of code changes, with implications for how VRT should be integrated into the maintenance toolchain.

AI.title_translation: 当视觉回归测试失败时，开发者究竟在讨论什么？
AI.tldr: 本研究通过实证分析发现，视觉回归测试（VRT）失败不仅引发关于样式问题的讨论，还常暴露出代码的非预期副作用，显著增加了开发者的沟通成本和解决时间。
AI.motivation: 探讨视觉回归测试（VRT）在实际开发中到底引发了开发人员怎样的讨论，并检验VRT是否仅仅局限于捕获传统的样式回归。
AI.method: 对来自103个GitHub仓库的307个包含VRT结果的PR与299个仅含图片附件的Visual PR进行定量对比，并通过卡片分类法对189个VRT标记的问题进行了定性缺陷分类分析。
AI.result: VRT-PR的解决时间是普通PR的中位数的3.8倍，评论多10倍，代码改动大1.75到4.5倍。VRT不仅能捕获布局、外观、颜色等样式问题（占多数），还能检测出未定义组件状态、内容消失等非样式问题及非局部代码副作用。
AI.conclusion: VRT不仅是有效的样式回归检查工具，还能作为捕获非预期代码副作用的辅助检测器，但同时也伴随着较长的解决时间和更高的沟通成本。
AI.translation: 视觉回归测试（VRTs）被广泛用作检测用户界面中意外视觉变化的机制。按设计，VRTs对渲染后的像素输出进行操作，主流假设是它们能捕获样式回归，如布局偏移、颜色不匹配和字体更改。我们对包含Chromatic的VRT结果的103个GitHub仓库的307个拉取请求（PR）进行了实证分析，并将其与包含图像附件但没有VRT的299个PR（Visual PRs）进行了比较。在定量方面，VRT-PRs的接受率没有显式差异，但其中位解决时间是Visual PRs的3.8倍，讨论评论多10倍，代码改动大1.75到4.5倍。VRT结果通常在审查过程的中期分享，以维持持续的讨论，而不仅仅是用作最终检查。通过对189个VRT标记问题的卡片分类分析，我们确定了分配给分析问题的七个缺陷类别：布局（39.7%）、外观（27.5%）、颜色（14.8%）、文本（9.5%）、状态（6.9%）、测试（6.3%）和图像（4.2%）。前三大类别是样式方面的，而大约18.5%的分析问题（35/189）涉及非样式起源，包括未定义的组件状态（13个案例）、内容消失（跨多个类别的17个案例）和视觉上难以察觉的回归（5个案例）。我们进一步记录了VRT检测到源自看似无关文件中的代码更改的视觉回归的案例，暴露了没有针对性测试会去捕获的非局部效应。这些观察表明，除了作为样式检查器的主要作用之外，VRT还充当了代码更改的意外后果的辅助检测器，对VRT应如何集成到维护工具链中具有重要意义。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对GitHub上数百个Pull Request的实证分析，探究了开发者在视觉回归测试（VRT）失败时所讨论的内容。研究发现，虽然VRT主要用于捕捉样式回归（如布局、外观和颜色），但它也常常作为检测代码非预期副作用的有力工具，同时也带来了更长的审查时间和更多的讨论。
AI.keywords: Visual Regression Testing, Empirical Analysis, User Interfaces, Pull Requests, Software Maintenance
AI.comments: 该论文通过大规模实证研究深入探讨了视觉回归测试（VRT）在实际软件开发中的讨论内容与影响。研究不仅挑战了VRT仅作为样式检查器的传统认知，还揭示了其在捕获非局部代码副作用方面的意外价值，对未来UI测试工具链的设计具有重要指导意义。

title: An Agentic Hybrid Top-Down and Bottom-Up Approach to Knowledge Graph Generation
summary: Organizing thousands of unstandardized, multilingual expertise declarations is a persistent challenge for Human Resources (HR) platforms, directly impacting downstream tasks like accurate talent matching. To address this, we propose a hybrid knowledge graph generation pipeline that grounds a Large Language Model (LLM) in the Wikidata multilingual Knowledge Graph (KG) while employing an agentic reflexion pattern to synthesize emerging concepts and their associated metadata. Unlike rigid top-down methods or fragmented bottom-up approaches, our system anchors recognized concepts to stable Knowledge Graph entities while dynamically creating new nodes and relational metadata for unrecognized skills. Executed across five stages, entity reconciliation, multilingual canonicalization, active curation, deduplication, and the iterative recovery of unmapped concepts, the system autonomously adapts to rapidly evolving, noisy skill mentions across five European languages. Ultimately, this pipeline provides a highly scalable, explicable, and self-healing framework for generating a comprehensive skills knowledge graph, from which a structured taxonomy is derived, using unstructured, noisy text.

AI.title_translation: 一种基于智能体混合自顶向下与自底向上方法的知识图谱生成技术
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于大语言模型和智能体反射机制的混合知识图谱生成管道，用于自动化处理和组织多语言、非标准的人才技能数据。
AI.motivation: 为了解决人力资源平台中组织成千上万个非标准化、多语言专业知识声明的持续挑战，从而直接影响人才匹配等下游任务。
AI.method: 提出一个包含五个阶段的混合知识图谱生成管道：实体对齐、多语言规范化、主动策划、去污与去重、以及未映射概念的迭代恢复，利用Wikidata作为基础并采用智能体反射模式。
AI.result: 系统能够跨五种欧洲语言自主适应快速演变且充满噪声的技能提及，成功生成一个可扩展、可解释且具备自愈能力的全面技能知识图谱。
AI.conclusion: 该管道提供了一个高可扩展、可解释且具自愈能力的框架，能够从未结构化、充满噪声的文本中生成全面的技能知识图谱并导出结构化分类法。
AI.translation: 组织成千上万个非标准化的、多语言的专业知识声明对于人力资源（HR）平台来说是一个持久的挑战，这直接影响了诸如精准人才匹配等下游任务。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种混合知识图谱生成管道，该管道将大语言模型（LLM）基于Wikidata多语言知识图谱（KG）进行锚定，同时采用智能体反射模式来合成新兴概念及其关联的元数据。与刚性的自顶向下方法或碎片化的自底向上方法不同，我们的系统将识别出的概念锚定到稳定的知识图谱实体上，同时为未识别的技能动态创建新节点和关系元数据。该系统分五个阶段执行：实体对齐、多语言规范化、主动策划、去重以及未映射概念的迭代恢复，从而跨五种欧洲语言自主适应快速演变、充满噪声的技能提及。最终，该管道为生成全面的技能知识图谱提供了一个高度可扩展、可解释且具自愈能力的框架，并由此从非结构化、充满噪声的文本中导出了结构化分类法。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种结合自顶向下与自底向上的智能体混合方法来生成知识图谱。通过将大语言模型与Wikidata多语言知识图谱接地，并应用智能体反射模式，该系统能有效处理人力资源平台中复杂的、多语言且充满噪声的非标准技能声明。
AI.keywords: 知识图谱生成, 大语言模型, 智能体反射, 技能分类法, 人力资源平台
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了自顶向下与自底向上的混合方法，利用大语言模型和Agentic反射模式，解决人力资源领域中多语言、非标准专业知识声明的知识图谱构建难题。方法具有自愈和可解释性，对处理大规模、噪声文本非常重要。

title: Ex-Post Equilibria: Structure and Computation
summary: This paper studies ex-post equilibria (EPEs) in simultaneous-move games with parameter uncertainty. We first compare EPEs with existing notions of robust equilibrium and provide a general foundation for EPEs as a solution concept for games with parameter uncertainty, and we show that EPEs are fully characterized by two game-theoretic properties (monotonicity and set-consistency). Since ex-post equilibria may fail to exist, we introduce the notion of an optimal approximate ex-post equilibrium, in which players adopt approximate best responses while minimizing the degree of suboptimality. We study the problem of computing EPEs and optimal approximate EPEs, focusing on two important classes of games: zero-sum games and concave potential games. We provide several hardness results, as well as a general class of computational approaches based on auxiliary minimax formulations.

AI.title_translation: 事后均衡：结构与计算
AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有参数不确定性的同时移动博弈中的事后均衡（EPE），提供了其基础理论，引入了最优近似EPE概念，并探讨了EPE的计算问题，包括难度结果和基于辅助极小极大公式的计算方法。
AI.motivation: 研究具有参数不确定性的同时移动博弈中的事后均衡（EPE），并解决其可能不存在的问题，以及如何计算它们。
AI.method: 比较EPE与现有的鲁棒均衡概念；为EPE作为博弈论解概念提供一般基础；用两个博弈论特性（单调性和集合一致性）刻画EPE；引入最优近似事后均衡的概念；研究EPE和最优近似EPE的计算问题，重点是零和博弈和凹势博弈；提供基于辅助极小极大公式的计算方法。
AI.result: EPEs与现有鲁棒均衡概念进行了比较；为EPE提供了作为具有参数不确定性博弈的解概念的通用基础；EPEs通过两个博弈论特性（单调性和集合一致性）完全刻画；引入了最优近似事后均衡的概念；提供了几个关于EPE和最优近似EPE计算的难度结果；提出了一类基于辅助极小极大公式的通用计算方法。
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 本文研究了具有参数不确定性的同时移动博弈中的事后均衡（EPE）。我们首先将EPE与现有的鲁棒均衡概念进行比较，并为EPE作为具有参数不确定性博弈的解概念提供了通用基础，我们还展示了EPEs通过两个博弈论特性（单调性和集合一致性）完全刻画。由于事后均衡可能不存在，我们引入了最优近似事后均衡的概念，其中玩家采用近似最优响应，同时最小化次优程度。我们研究了计算EPE和最优近似EPE的问题，重点是两类重要的博弈：零和博弈和凹势博弈。我们提供了几个难度结果，以及一类基于辅助极小极大公式的通用计算方法。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了具有参数不确定性的同时移动博弈中的事后均衡（EPE）。研究内容包括将EPE与现有鲁棒均衡概念进行比较，为其作为解概念提供理论基础，并揭示其由单调性和集合一致性两个特性所刻画。鉴于EPE可能不存在，论文引入了最优近似事后均衡的概念。此外，文章还深入研究了EPE及其近似形式的计算问题，特别是在零和博弈和凹势博弈中，提出了计算难度结果和基于辅助极小极大公式的通用计算方法。
AI.keywords: 事后均衡, 参数不确定性, 博弈论, 最优近似均衡, 计算复杂性
AI.comments: 这篇论文在博弈论领域，特别是处理参数不确定性问题方面具有重要意义。它不仅为事后均衡提供了坚实的理论基础和明确的特性刻画，还通过引入近似均衡概念解决了其可能不存在的局限性。计算复杂性和提出的基于极小极大公式的通用计算方法，对实际应用和进一步研究都具有启发性。

title: PyFlow: An Inter-procedural Static Analysis Framework for Python
summary:
Static program analysis infers program properties automatically. Yet precise interprocedural analysis remains challenging, and dynamically typed languages amplify the difficulty. Python is particularly problematic: dynamic dispatch, first-class functions, metaprogramming, pervasive exceptions, and an object model based on descriptors and attribute-driven lookup collectively impede precise reasoning.
  We present PyFlow, a generic IFDS-based static-analysis framework for Python. PyFlow provides a multi-stage intermediate-representation pipeline and a generic IFDS solver parameterized by abstract domains. Analysis developers implement only the dataflow semantics; the framework constructs the supergraph, performs fixed-point iteration, and caches summaries.
  We implement a taint analysis in \pyflow and evaluate it against eight Python SAST tools (DevSkim, Dlint, Bandit, Bearer, CodeQL, Pysa, Semgrep, and Snyk) on the synthetic and real-world benchmarks from a recent ICSE~'26 study. On the synthetic benchmark, PyFlow achieves the best aggregate recall and F1 score among all nine tools. On the real-world benchmark, it attains the highest recall and F1 score while maintaining precision competitive with taint-based engines. We conclude with lessons learned from building IFDS analyses for Python.

AI.title_translation: PyFlow：一个用于Python的跨过程静态分析框架
AI.tldr: PyFlow是一个创新的Python静态分析框架，利用IFDS算法有效克服了Python动态特性的挑战，在污点分析测试中取得了领先的准确率。
AI.motivation: 精确的跨过程静态分析本就充满挑战，而Python等动态类型语言由于动态分派、一等函数、元编程及基于描述符的属性查找等特性，使得精确推理更加困难。现有工具在处理这些问题时存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于IFDS的通用Python静态分析框架PyFlow，包含多阶段中间表示（IR）流水线和参数化抽象域的通用IFDS求解器，并基于此实现了污点分析。
AI.result: 在合成基准测试中，PyFlow在所有九个工具中取得了最佳的综合召回率和F1分数；在真实世界的基准测试中，它也获得了最高的召回率和F1分数，同时保持了与现有污点分析引擎相当的精确度。
AI.conclusion: PyFlow通过提供多阶段中间表示流水线和通用的IFDS求解器，有效解决了Python动态特性的静态分析难题，在真实和合成基准测试中表现出色。
AI.translation:
静态程序分析可以自动推导程序的属性。然而，精确的跨过程分析仍然具有挑战性，而动态类型语言更增加了这种难度。Python尤为棘手：动态分派、一等函数、元编程、无处不在的异常，以及基于描述符和属性驱动查找的对象模型，共同阻碍了精确的推理。
我们提出了PyFlow，一个针对Python的通用、基于IFDS的静态分析框架。PyFlow提供了一个多阶段中间表示流水线和一个由抽象域参数化的通用IFDS求解器。分析开发者只需实现数据flow语义；框架负责构建超图、执行不动点迭代并缓存摘要。
我们在PyFlow中实现了一种污点分析，并将其与最近ICSE '26研究中的合成和真实世界基准测试上的八个Python SAST工具（DevSkim、Dlint、Bandit、Bearer、CodeQL、Pysa、Semgrep和Snyk）进行了评估。在合成基准测试中，PyFlow在所有九个工具中实现了最佳的综合召回率和F1分数。在真实世界基准测试中，它获得了最高的召回率和F1分数，同时保持了与基于污点引擎相竞争的精确度。最后，我们总结了为Python构建IFDS分析所学到的经验教训。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了PyFlow，这是一个针对Python的通用基于IFDS的静态分析框架。它通过多阶段IR流水线和参数化IFDS求解器简化了数据流分析的开发，并在污点分析评估中展现了领先的召回率和F1分数。
AI.keywords: Python, 静态分析, IFDS, 污点分析, 中间表示
AI.comments: PyFlow作为一种基于IFDS的通用Python静态分析框架，成功克服了Python动态特性带来的挑战，在污点分析评估中展现出优异的召回率和F1分数，具有很高的实用价值和学术意义。

title: Linear Stochastic Systems with i.i.d. uncertainties: Exact Covariance Characterization, Stability Analysis and State-feedback Design
summary: This paper studies linear discrete-time systems affected by independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) multiplicative uncertainties and additive noise. It establishes the main links between covariance recursions, the spectral properties of associated Kronecker-based matrices, and mean-square stability, and exploits these links to derive tractable conditions for controller synthesis. We first derive a deterministic covariance recursion within the tube-based Stochastic Model Predictive Control (SMPC) framework using a Kronecker product based matrix augmentation. For linear stochastic systems with multiplicative uncertainty and without additive noise, we show that the full-space matrix representation arising from the covariance recursion has the same spectral radius as its symmetric-space counterpart. Combined with the existing symmetric-space characterization, this establishes that Schur stability of the full-space augmented matrix is equivalent to mean-square stability. For state-feedback design, we propose new sufficient Linear Matrix Inequality (LMI) conditions that are numerically more tractable owing to their reduced size compared with the conventional necessary and sufficient conditions. Numerical tests illustrate the usefulness of the covariance characterization for recursively estimating the covariance without relying on sampling-based methods. We also assess the computational burden of the proposed LMI conditions and their conservatism relative to the necessary and sufficient ones.

AI.title_translation: 具有独立同分布不确定性的线性随机系统：精确协方差表征、稳定性分析与状态反馈设计
AI.tldr: 本文研究了含乘性不确定性和加性噪声的线性随机系统的精确协方差表征与稳定性，并提出了高效的状态反馈LMI设计方法。
AI.motivation: 为了解决具有独立同分布（i.i.d.）乘性不确定性和加性噪声的线性离散时间系统的稳定性分析和控制器综合问题，克服传统方法计算复杂度高或依赖采样的问题。
AI.method: 利用克罗内克积进行矩阵扩充，推导管基随机模型预测控制（SMPC）框架下的确定性协方差递推，分析全空间与对称空间矩阵的谱半径，并提出用于状态反馈设计的降阶充分线性矩阵不等式（LMI）条件。
AI.result: 证明了全空间增广矩阵的Schur稳定性与均方稳定性等价，且其谱半径与对称空间对应矩阵相同；提出了数值上更易处理的降阶LMI状态反馈设计条件，数值测试验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了线性随机系统中协方差递推、矩阵谱性质与均方稳定性的等价关系，并提出了高效的LMI状态反馈控制器设计方法。
AI.translation: 本文研究了受独立同分布（i.i.d.）乘性不确定性和加性噪声影响的线性离散时间系统。它建立了协方差递推、相关Kronecker基矩阵的谱性质以及均方稳定性之间的主要联系，并利用这些联系推导出了用于控制器综合的可处理条件。我们首先在基于管道的随机模型预测控制（SMPC）框架内，使用基于克罗内克积的矩阵扩充推导了确定性协方差递推。对于具有乘性不确定性且无加性噪声的线性随机系统，我们证明了由协方差递推产生的全空间矩阵表示与其对称空间对应矩阵具有相同的谱半径。结合现有的对称空间表征，这确立了全空间扩充矩阵的Schur稳定性与均方稳定性是等价的。对于状态反馈设计，我们提出了新的充分线性矩阵不等式（LMI）条件，由于其尺寸比传统的充要条件更小，因此在数值上更易于处理。数值测试说明了协方差表征在不依赖基于采样的方法的情况下递归估计协方差的有用性。我们还评估了所提出的LMI条件的计算负担以及它们相对于充要条件的保守性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了含i.i.d.乘性不确定性和加性噪声的线性离散时间系统，建立了协方差递推、Kronecker矩阵谱性质与均方稳定性的内在联系，证明了全空间与对称空间矩阵谱半径的一致性，并开发了高效的降阶LMI状态反馈设计方法。
AI.keywords: 线性随机系统, 乘性不确定性, 均方稳定性, 协方差递推, 线性矩阵不等式(LMI)
AI.comments: 该论文在具有乘性不确定性和加性噪声的离散线性随机系统研究中取得了重要进展，通过克罗内克积矩阵扩充和确定性协方差递推，统一了全空间与对称空间的谱性质，并提出了计算上更易处理的LMI状态反馈设计条件，具有很高的理论与应用价值。

title: Hyperbolic Graph Embedders for Link Prediction and Topology Reconstruction
summary: Hyperbolic embeddings provide compact geometric representations of complex networks in hyperbolic spaces, but systematic comparisons of methods developed in machine learning, network science, and algorithmics remain rare. We benchmark 13 unsupervised hyperbolic graph embedders under a unified protocol for link prediction and topology reconstruction on synthetic and empirical networks. The protocol captures both missing-link recovery and the preservation of local and global network structure. Maximum-likelihood and representation-learning-based approaches, including hybrid variants, achieve the strongest overall performance, although no method dominates across all tasks and structural regimes. Performance is more strongly associated with embedding paradigm than with disciplinary origin. We identify the network regimes in which different paradigms succeed or fail and provide practical guidance for method selection in downstream applications.

AI.title_translation: 用于链路预测与拓扑重构的双曲图嵌入器
AI.tldr: 本文首次对13种无监督双曲图嵌入方法进行了全面的统一基准测试，发现最大似然法和表示学习法表现最佳，并为网络拓扑重构和链路预测提供了实用的方法选择指南。
AI.motivation: 尽管双曲嵌入能为复杂网络提供紧凑的几何表示，但来自机器学习、网络科学和算法领域的各种方法缺乏系统性的比较，且其在不同网络结构和任务中的表现尚不明确。
AI.method: 在一个统一的协议下，对来自机器学习、网络科学和算法等不同领域的13种无监督双曲图嵌入方法（包括最大似然法、表示学习法及其混合变体）进行了基准测试，涵盖合成网络和真实网络，用于评估链路预测以及局部和全局网络结构的重构能力。
AI.result: 最大似然法和基于表示学习的方法（包括混合变体）取得了整体最强的性能，但没有哪一种方法能够在所有的任务和网络结构区间中都占主导地位。算法性能与嵌入范式的关联度远大于与其学科来源的关联度。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入范式比学科来源更能决定算法性能；最大似然法和表示学习法（含混合变体）表现最佳，但没有单一方法能在所有任务和结构区间中占绝对优势。论文明确了各范式的适用与失效区间，并提供了实用的方法选择指南。
AI.translation: 双曲嵌入为复杂网络在双曲空间中提供了紧凑的几何表示，但机器学习、网络科学和算法领域中开发的方法之间系统性的比较仍然很少。我们在统一协议下对13种无监督双曲图嵌入器进行了基准测试，用于合成网络和经验网络上的链路预测和拓扑重构。该协议同时捕捉了缺失链路的恢复以及局部和全局网络结构的保持。基于最大似然和表示学习的方法（包括混合变体）总体表现最强，尽管没有一种方法能够在所有任务和结构区间中占主导地位。性能与嵌入范式的关联性比与学科来源的关联性更强。我们确定了不同范式成功或失败的网络区间，并为下游应用中的方法选择提供了实用指导。
AI.summary: 该论文对13种无监督双曲图嵌入方法进行了统一的基准测试，以评估其在链路预测和拓扑重构方面的性能。结果表明，最大似然法和表示学习法（及混合变体）表现最优，且算法性能更多取决于嵌入范式而非学科来源，研究最后为下游应用提供了实用的方法选择指南。
AI.keywords: 双曲图嵌入, 链路预测, 拓扑重构, 复杂网络, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该论文对来自机器学习、网络科学和算法领域的13种无监督双曲图嵌入方法进行了统一的基准测试，填补了该领域系统性比较的空白，并为下游应用中的方法选择提供了宝贵的实践指导。

title: ZIPBrain: Can EEG Foundation Models Be Faster, Locally Deployable, but Accurate?
summary: This work investigates whether Electroencephalograph (EEG) foundation models (EFMs) can be made faster and locally deployable without sacrificing accuracy. EEG foundation models are a major trend, offering strong general-purpose representations. However, their computational burden grows quadratically with input length, hindering deployment on resource-constrained scenario, particularly for real-time clinical monitoring. EEG's low SNR further suggests many of these tokens are redundant and compressible with little accuracy cost. We propose ZIPBrain, a novel redundancy-aware EEG token pooling module that leverages this low-SNR characteristic to reduce token count. Given a token sequence, ZIPBrain partitions tokens into redundant and unique groups, then merges each redundant token with its most similar counterpart in the unique group. Furthermore, ZIPBrain serves as a training-free, plug-and-play module that seamlessly integrates into standard Transformer encoders with negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments across multiple EEG foundation models show ZIPBrain's strong versatility, achieving 1.3%-10.5% average improvement over baselines, while reducing wall-clock inference time by 32.7% (up to 41.8% with CUDA Graph) compared to the original EEG foundation models.

AI.title_translation: ZIPBrain：脑电图基础模型能否做到更快、可本地部署且准确？
AI.tldr: ZIPBrain是一个无需训练、即插即用的EEG令牌池化模块，能在减少推理时间的同时提升EEG基础模型的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的脑电图基础模型（EFMs）计算负担随输入长度呈二次方增长，难以在资源受限场景（如实时临床监测）中进行本地部署；同时，脑电图低信噪比的特征表明许多令牌是冗余且可压缩的。
AI.method: 提出ZIPBrain模块，将令牌序列划分为冗余组和独特组，并将每个冗余组中的令牌与其在独特组中最相似的对应令牌进行合并。该模块无需训练，可作为即插即用组件无缝集成到标准Transformer编码器中。
AI.result: 在多个EEG基础模型上的广泛实验表明，ZIPBrain平均准确率提升了1.3%-10.5%，同时将墙钟推理时间减少了32.7%（使用CUDA Graph时高达41.8%）。
AI.conclusion: ZIPBrain通过冗余感知令牌池化，有效解决了EEG基础模型计算开销大和实时部署难的问题，在保持甚至提升准确率的同时显著加快了推理速度。
AI.translation: 本工作研究了脑电图（EEG）基础模型（EFMs）是否能在不牺牲准确性的前提下变得更快且可本地部署。EEG基础模型是当前的主流趋势，提供了强大的通用表征。然而，它们的计算负担随输入长度呈二次方增长，阻碍了其在资源受限场景（特别是实时临床监测）中的部署。EEG的低信噪比进一步表明，许多这样的令牌是冗余的，可以在付出很小准确性代价的情况下进行压缩。我们提出了ZIPBrain，一个新颖的冗余感知EEG令牌池化模块，它利用这一低信噪比特性来减少令牌数量。给定一个令牌序列，ZIPBrain将令牌划分为冗余组和独特组，然后将每个冗余组中的令牌与其在独特组中最相似的对应令牌进行合并。此外，ZIPBrain作为一个无需训练的即插即用模块，能够无缝集成到标准的Transformer编码器中，且计算开销微乎其微。在多个EEG基础模型上的广泛实验展示了ZIPBrain强大的通用性，相比原始的EEG基础模型，平均准确率提升了1.3%-10.5%，同时墙钟推理时间减少了32.7%（结合CUDA Graph时高达41.8%）。
AI.summary: ZIPBrain是一个针对EEG基础模型的冗余感知令牌池化模块，它利用脑电信号低信噪比的特点合并冗余令牌。作为一个无需训练、即插即用的模块，它在减少推理时间的同时提升了模型的准确率。
AI.keywords: EEG foundation models, token pooling, redundancy-aware, real-time monitoring, resource-constrained
AI.comments: 本文针对脑电图基础模型计算开销大、无法在资源受限场景下实时部署的痛点，创新性地利用脑电信号低信噪比的特点，提出了一个无需训练、即插即用的令牌池化模块ZIPBrain。该方法不仅大幅减少了计算时间，还在多个模型上提升了准确率，具有很高的实用价值。

title: MISO: Model-Internal-State-Guided Optimization for Ranking Models
comments: Accepted at the OARS Workshop at ACM RecSys 2026
summary: Ranking models are repeatedly refined within established model families, yet the choice of which component to scale, replace, or retire is often guided by expensive trial-and-error. We present Model Internal State Optimization (MISO), a systems workflow that uses model internal states (MIS), including parameters, activations, gradients, and normalization statistics, to prioritize such local optimization decisions. MISO extracts MIS from a trained ranking model, aggregates them into ranking, alignment, and comparison signals, and converts those signals into a small set of interpretable candidate edits. Because MIS are re-extracted after each retraining cycle, MISO naturally supports an adaptive optimization workflow that tracks evolving model behavior as data distributions and system requirements shift over time. In an ads ranking case study, MISO improves normalized entropy while requiring substantially fewer validation runs than expert-driven and black-box scaling workflows, offering a practical middle ground between manual tuning and opaque automated search.
comment: Accepted at the OARS Workshop at ACM RecSys 2026

AI.title_translation: MISO：面向排序模型的模型内部状态引导优化
AI.tldr: MISO是一种利用模型内部状态（参数、激活、梯度、归一化统计信息）来指导排序模型优化的新方法。它通过提取和分析这些状态来生成可解释的优化建议，从而减少了昂贵的试错过程。在广告排序的案例研究中，MISO在减少验证运行次数的同时提高了归一化熵，提供了一种介于手动调整和不透明自动化搜索之间的实用方法。
AI.motivation: 排序模型在现有模型家族中不断得到改进，但选择扩展、替换或淘汰哪个组件通常依赖于昂贵的试错法。现有方法缺乏一种有效的方法来指导这些优化决策。
AI.method: MISO通过提取训练好的排序模型的模型内部状态（MIS），包括参数、激活、梯度和归一化统计信息，将它们聚合成排序、对齐和比较信号，并将这些信号转换为一套小型的、可解释的候选编辑。由于每次再训练周期后都会重新提取MIS，MISO自然支持一种自适应优化工作流，以跟踪数据分布和系统需求变化时模型行为的演变。
AI.result: 在广告排序的案例研究中，MISO在需要显著少于专家驱动和黑盒扩展工作流的验证运行次数的情况下，提高了归一化熵。
AI.conclusion: MISO提供了一种实用的方法，利用模型内部状态来指导排序模型的优化，减少了试错成本，并能适应模型行为随时间的变化，在实践中是一种介于手动调优和不透明自动化搜索之间的有效折衷方案。
AI.translation: 排序模型在已建立的模型家族中被反复改进，但选择扩展、替换或淘汰哪个组件的决定通常依赖于昂贵的试错。我们提出了模型内部状态优化（MISO），这是一种系统工作流，它使用模型内部状态（MIS），包括参数、激活、梯度和归一化统计信息，来优先考虑这些局部的优化决策。MISO从训练好的排序模型中提取MIS，将它们聚合成排序、对齐和比较信号，并将这些信号转换为一小组可解释的候选编辑。由于每次再训练周期后都会重新提取MIS，MISO自然支持一种自适应优化工作流，以跟踪数据分布和系统需求变化时模型行为的演变。在广告排序的案例研究中，MISO在需要比专家驱动和黑盒扩展工作流少得多的验证运行次数的情况下，提高了归一化熵，在手动调整和不透明的自动搜索之间提供了一个实用的折衷方案。
AI.summary: MISO（模型内部状态优化）是一种新的系统工作流，它利用排序模型的内部状态（如参数、激活、梯度和归一化统计信息）来指导优化决策，从而减少昂贵的试错。通过提取和分析这些状态，MISO生成可解释的优化建议，并支持自适应优化，以应对不断变化的数据分布和系统需求。在广告排序的案例研究中，MISO在减少验证运行次数的同时提高了归一化熵，提供了一种介于手动调整和不透明自动化搜索之间的实用方法。
AI.keywords: 排序模型, 模型内部状态, 优化, MISO, 广告排序
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的MISO方法，利用模型内部状态来指导排序模型的优化，这在减少计算成本和提高效率方面具有重要意义。然而，该方法的可解释性和通用性有待进一步验证。

title: CAS2UML: A Handwritten Sketch-to-PlantUML Dataset for Class and Activity Diagrams
summary: Automated UML generation from sketches and images is gaining renewed attention with the rise of large language models and multimodal AI. However, reproducible evaluation remains difficult due to the lack of public datasets with executable groundtruth models. We present CAS2UML, a public dataset of 557 handdrawn UML diagrams, including 271 class diagrams and 286 activity diagrams, each paired with manually validated PlantUML code. We also provide a PlantUML-based validation tool and reusable scripts for checking the syntactic correctness and renderability of generated UML artifacts, enabling reproducible benchmarking of sketch-to-UML approaches. The dataset, validation tool, processing scripts, documentation, and demonstration video are publicly available at: Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Seym0n /cas2uml_hand-drawn_to_plantuml_dataset; Tool and Scripts: https://github.com/Seym0n/handwritten-uml-dataset; Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KQrYeGgT3hs.

AI.title_translation: CAS2UML：一个用于类图和活动图的手绘草图到PlantUML数据集
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了CAS2UML数据集，包含557张手绘UML图（类图和活动图）及其对应的PlantUML代码，并提供验证工具和脚本，以促进草图到UML生成方法的评估。
AI.motivation: 现有草图到UML生成方法难以进行可复现的评估，因为缺乏包含可执行地面真实模型（PlantUML代码）的公共数据集。
AI.method: 创建了一个包含557张手绘UML图（271张类图，286张活动图）的数据集，每张图都配有手动验证的PlantUML代码。同时提供了一个基于PlantUML的验证工具和可重用脚本，用于检查生成UML文件的语法正确性和可渲染性。
AI.result: 发布了一个名为CAS2UML的公共数据集，包含手绘UML图及其对应的PlantUML代码，并提供配套的验证工具和脚本，支持可复现的基准测试。
AI.conclusion: CAS2UML数据集及其配套工具和脚本的发布，为草图到UML生成方法的研究提供了重要的资源，能够促进该领域的可复现评估和发展。
AI.translation: 自动从草图和图像生成UML正获得日益增长的关注，这得益于大型语言模型和多模态AI的兴起。然而，由于缺乏包含可执行地面真实模型的公共数据集，可复现的评估仍然很困难。我们提出了CAS2UML，一个包含557张手绘UML图的公共数据集，包括271张类图和286张活动图，每张图都配有手动验证的PlantUML代码。我们还提供了一个基于PlantUML的验证工具和可重用的脚本，用于检查生成UML文件的语法正确性和可渲染性，从而能够对草图到UML方法进行可复现的基准测试。该数据集、验证工具、处理脚本、文档和演示视频可在以下网址公开获取：数据集：https://huggingface.co/datasets/Seym0n /cas2uml_hand-drawn_to_plantuml_dataset；工具和脚本：https://github.com/Seym0n/handwritten-uml-dataset；视频：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KQrYeGgT3hs。
AI.summary: CAS2UML是一个新发布的数据集，包含557张手绘的类图和活动图，以及对应的PlantUML代码。该数据集旨在解决草图到UML生成方法评估中可复现性不足的问题，并附带验证工具和脚本，以支持该领域的研究。
AI.keywords: UML,草图识别,数据集,PlantUML,类图
AI.comments: 该数据集的创新之处在于提供了手绘草图与可执行PlantUML代码的配对，并辅以验证工具，极大地促进了草图到UML生成技术的评估和发展。其重要性体现在为AI模型（特别是多模态和大型语言模型）在该领域的应用提供了坚实的基础。然而，数据集的规模（557张图）可能仍然有限，未来可以考虑增加更多样化的图和手绘风格。

title: Accounting Graph Transformer for Short-History Multi-KPI Forecasting in Small Businesses
summary: Small businesses often have only 12-24 months of accounting history, yet planning and risk workflows require coordinated forecasts across financial statements. We study joint 12-month forecasting of 13 income-statement, balance-sheet, cash-flow, and working-capital key performance indicators (KPIs) from 71 monthly ledger series. We introduce the Accounting Graph Transformer (AGT), which represents each ledger series as a masked token, exchanges information through typed attention on a fixed accounting-relation graph, pools target-specific context, and fuses it with a gated three-month recency path. Across 11,993 forecast origins from 1,060 unseen companies, AGT achieves sample-weighted KPI-macro mean absolute error (MAE) $0.6990 \pm 0.0013$ over three independent seeds, compared with $0.7378 \pm 0.0014$ for the strongest baseline, LightGBM. At the pre-specified seed 42, a paired company-clustered bootstrap gives a LightGBM-minus-AGT difference of 0.0395 with 95% confidence interval (CI) $[0.0350,0.0439]$. AGT is best on all 13 KPIs against LightGBM, TimeMixer, and SOFTS in the matched seed-42 comparison, while final-architecture ablations show that relational attention, accounting topology, and the recency path each improve validation and test accuracy. On 7,094 additional unseen companies with origins sampled from January-May 2025, AGT obtains 0.7548 MAE versus 0.7694 for SOFTS. A single 5.3M-parameter model produces 156 aligned forecasts without company-specific fitting, providing one forecasting layer for integrated planning, liquidity, and working-capital analysis.

AI.title_translation: 面向小微企业短历史多KPI预测的会计图Transformer
AI.tldr: 提出会计图Transformer（AGT），在小微企业短历史、多KPI财务预测任务中表现优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 小微企业通常只有12-24个月的会计历史，但规划和风险工作流程需要跨财务报表的协调预测，传统的单一或非结构化预测方法难以满足需求。
AI.method: 提出会计图Transformer（AGT），将每个总账序列表示为掩码令牌，通过固定会计关系图上的类型化注意力进行信息交换，汇聚目标特定上下文，并与门控的三个月近期路径进行融合。
AI.result: 在11,993个预测起点和1,060家未见过公司的数据集上，AGT实现了样本加权KPI宏观平均绝对误差（MAE）0.6990，优于最强基线LightGBM（0.7378），且在所有13个KPI上均表现最优。
AI.conclusion: 会计图Transformer（AGT）通过将总账序列表示为掩码令牌，并在固定会计关系图上进行类型化注意力交互，成功实现了小微企业短期历史下的多KPI联合精确预测。
AI.translation: 小微企业通常只有12-24个月的会计历史，但规划和风险工作流程要求跨财务报表进行协调预测。我们研究了从71个月度总账序列中联合预测13个损益表、资产负债表、现金流量表和营运资本关键绩效指标（KPI）的12个月预测任务。我们引入了会计图Transformer（AGT），它将每个总账序列表示为一个掩码令牌，通过固定会计关系图上的类型化注意力交换信息，汇聚目标特定上下文，并将其与门控的三个月近期路径相融合。在来自1,060家未见公司的11,993个预测起点上，经过三个独立随机种子验证，AGT实现了样本加权的KPI宏观平均绝对误差（MAE）0.6990±0.0013，而最强的基线LightGBM为0.7378±0.0014。在预先指定的种子42下，成对公司聚类自助法得到的LightGBM减去AGT的差值为0.0395，95%置信区间为[0.0350, 0.0439]。在匹配的种子42比较中，AGT在所有13个KPI上均优于LightGBM、TimeMixer和SOFTS，而最终架构消融实验表明，关系注意力、会计拓扑结构和近期路径均能提高验证和测试准确率。在来自2025年1月至5月采样起点的7,094家额外未见公司上，AGT获得了0.7548的MAE，而SOFTS为0.7694。单个包含530万个参数的模型可生成156个对齐的预测，无需针对特定公司进行拟合，从而为集成规划、流动性和营运资本分析提供了一个预测层。
AI.summary: 本文提出了会计图Transformer（AGT），用于解决小微企业短历史条件下的多关键绩效指标（KPI）联合预测问题。模型通过融合会计关系图注意力机制与短期历史路径，实现了无需针对特定公司拟合的跨财务报表高精度联合预测。
AI.keywords: 会计图Transformer, 短期历史预测, 多KPI预测, 小微企业, 财务报表联合预测

title: Beyond Text Matching: Towards Reference-Free Evaluation for Human-Oriented Binary Reverse Engineering
comments: Accepted by the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
summary:
Human-Oriented Binary Reverse Engineering (HOBRE) aims to transform decompiled pseudocode into a more human-friendly representation, thereby reducing the cognitive burden of reverse analysis and improving efficiency. However, reliably evaluating HOBRE outputs remains a fundamental challenge: human evaluation is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to scale, while existing automated metrics either require executable test cases and runtime environments that are often unavailable for real-world binaries, or rely on high-quality source code references that are typically inaccessible and fail to capture semantically equivalent but lexically diverse outputs. Although LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm is naturally well-suited to HOBRE evaluation, its effectiveness remains underexplored.
  This paper presents the first systematic investigation of the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm for HOBRE across three representative tasks: function name recovery, binary code summarization, and decompilation optimization. We introduce BinJudgeBench, the first expert-annotated, reference-free evaluation benchmark based on multi-dimensional human judgment, where LLM-as-a-Judge achieves an average correlation of 63.20\% with human judgment, outperforming traditional automated metrics at 35.04\%. By analyzing judge configurations across backbone LLMs, prompting strategies, and decoding temperatures, we find that no ``one-size-fits-all'' configuration exists, as the optimal setup varies across tasks and individual samples. To address this, we propose BinJudge, which employs a lightweight routing mechanism to adaptively select the optimal judge configuration for each task and sample. BinJudge improves correlation with human experts by 4.5\%-24.7\% and reduces API cost to 0.06$\times$-0.84$\times$ of that of static best configurations, providing a scalable, cost-effective, and high-fidelity automated evaluation scheme for HOBRE.

AI.title_translation: 超越文本匹配：面向人类的二进制逆向工程的无参考评估
AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统地研究了LLM-as-a-Judge范式在人类导向的二进制逆向工程（HOBRE）中的应用，并提出了名为BinJudge的新方法，通过自适应选择最佳的LLM评判配置来提高评估的准确性和成本效益。

AI.method: 研究了LLM-as-a-Judge范式在函数名称恢复、二进制代码摘要和反编译优化三个HOBRE任务上的应用，并提出了BinJudge，一个包含轻量级路由机制的自适应评判方法。
AI.result: 在BinJudgeBench基准测试中，LLM-as-a-Judge与人类判断的平均相关性为63.20%，优于传统自动化指标的35.04%。BinJudge通过自适应选择评判配置，将与人类专家的相关性提高了4.5%-24.7%，并将API成本降低到静态最佳配置的0.06倍-0.84倍。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-a-Judge范式为HOBRE评估提供了一种有前景的解决方案，但需要根据具体任务和样本自适应地调整评判配置。提出的BinJudge方法通过自适应路由机制，实现了可扩展、成本效益高且高保真的自动化评估。
AI.translation:
人类导向的二进制逆向工程（HOBRE）旨在将反编译的伪代码转换为更易于人类理解的表示形式，从而减轻逆向分析的认知负担并提高效率。然而，可靠地评估HOBRE的输出仍然是一个基本挑战：人工评估成本高、耗时长且难以扩展，而现有的自动化指标要么需要通常无法用于真实二进制文件的可执行测试用例和运行时环境，要么依赖通常无法访问且无法捕捉语义上等价但词汇上不同的输出的高质量源代码参考。尽管LLM-as-a-Judge范式天然适合HOBRE评估，但其有效性仍有待充分探索。
该论文首次系统地研究了LLM-as-a-Judge范式在HOBRE中的应用，涵盖了函数名称恢复、二进制代码摘要和反编译优化三个代表性任务。我们引入了BinJudgeBench，这是第一个基于多维度人类判断的、经过专家注释的、无参考的评估基准，其中LLM-as-a-Judge与人类判断的平均相关性为63.20%，优于传统自动化指标的35.04%。通过分析不同骨干LLM、提示策略和解码温度下的评判配置，我们发现不存在“一刀切”的配置，因为最佳设置因任务和单个样本而异。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了BinJudge，它采用轻量级的路由机制来为每个任务和样本自适应地选择最佳的评判配置。BinJudge将与人类专家的相关性提高了4.5%-24.7%，并将API成本降低到静态最佳配置的0.06倍-0.84倍，为HOBRE提供了一种可扩展、成本效益高且高保真的自动化评估方案。
AI.summary: 本研究首次系统地评估了LLM-as-a-Judge范式在人类导向的二进制逆向工程（HOBRE）中的应用，解决了现有评估方法的局限性。研究人员提出了BinJudgeBench基准，并发现LLM-as-a-Judge的性能优于传统指标。为进一步优化，他们提出了BinJudge方法，该方法通过自适应选择LLM评判配置，显著提高了评估准确性并降低了成本，为HOBRE提供了一种更优的自动化评估方案。
AI.keywords: 人类导向的二进制逆向工程, LLM-as-a-Judge, 无参考评估, BinJudgeBench, BinJudge
AI.comments: 该研究解决了HOBRE评估中的关键挑战，提出的BinJudgeBench和BinJudge方法在提高评估准确性和降低成本方面取得了显著进展。然而，对于“一刀切”配置不存在的发现，以及BinJudge的自适应路由机制，其在不同领域和复杂度的HOBRE任务上的泛化能力仍有待进一步验证。此外，LLM本身的潜在偏见和不稳定性也可能影响评估结果的可靠性。

title: Not All Problems Are Best Modeled as MILP: A DSL-Centric Framework for Flexible and Accurate Optimization Modeling
summary: Solving combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) requires not only efficient algorithms but also carefully crafted formulations. While recent works have leveraged LLMs to automate optimization modeling, current frameworks predominantly rely on a rigid mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) paradigm. In this paper, we argue that not all problems are best modeled as MILP, as forcing complex domains into linear constraints can induce prohibitive modeling complexity and severely restrict solver flexibility. To address this, we propose OptiDSL, a framework that shifts the focus from rigid MILP formulations to domain-specific language (DSL) representations. By utilizing LLMs to map natural language onto standardized, domain-accepted structures, OptiDSL decouples problem formulation from execution. This paradigm enables seamless integration with a diverse library of specialized solvers, ranging from traditional heuristics to modern learning-based methods. Experimental results on the comprehensive benchmark of 44 COP types show that OptiDSL significantly surpasses MILP-based pipelines, yielding a 51.66% gain in formulation accuracy and a 91.71% decrease in modeling time. Notably, it also outperforms MILP-based pipelines on the existing benchmark, achieving a 23.09% higher formulation accuracy. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/OptiDSL.

title: Tensor Network Kernel Machines: A JAX Framework for Machine Learning and Nonlinear System Identification
comments: 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables, 1 listing. Code available at: https://github.com/AlbMLpy/tnkm
summary: Developing nonlinear models that are both expressive and computationally efficient remains a challenge in machine learning and nonlinear system identification. Tensor network kernel machines (TNKM) address this challenge by combining nonlinear feature representations with compact low-rank tensor-network parameterizations. However, practical and extensible software frameworks for developing TNKM models remain limited. In this work, we introduce "tnkm", an open-source Python library for constructing and training TNKM models using JAX. The library provides a unified interface for combining different feature maps, tensor-network architectures, and optimization strategies, including alternating least squares and gradient-based methods. We demonstrate the capabilities of "tnkm" on nonlinear benchmark problems, showing that the implemented models achieve competitive prediction accuracy while retaining compact parameterizations and efficient training. The proposed framework facilitates reproducible development and application of tensor-network-based learning methods.

title: C2Dex: Contact-Consistent Reconstruction and Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Video
comments: 9 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Project page: https://k-jie.github.io/C2Dex/
summary: High-quality demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation are costly and difficult to collect, whereas monocular human videos provide a scalable source of diverse manipulation behaviors. However, transferring such demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging: monocular hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction often produces temporally unstable contacts and physically implausible interactions, while conventional retargeting methods struggle to preserve task-relevant contacts and local interaction geometry across different hand embodiments. We present C2Dex, a video-to-dexterous-manipulation framework built around a shared interaction representation: stable object-side contacts recovered by aggregating noisy frame-wise observations in the canonical object space. These stable contacts serve a dual role: as trajectory-level constraints that guide reconstruction toward temporally coherent and physically plausible human HOI trajectories, and as explicit transfer targets for the dexterous hand, where Laplacian interaction optimization preserves the local hand-object geometry across embodiments and residual reinforcement learning refines the trajectory in simulation. Experiments on DexYCB and TACO show that C2Dex achieves end-to-end trajectory success rates of 57.78% and 26.67%, respectively, substantially outperforming the strongest baselines (17.78% and 10.00%) under identical evaluation criteria. Real-robot replay experiments further demonstrate physical feasibility across diverse contact-rich manipulation tasks. Project page: https://k-jie.github.io/C2Dex/

title: Stationarity is not enough: tightness of the quantum mechanical bootstrap and the copositive cone
comments: 7 pages, 2 tables. Ancillary files contain the explicit rational moment vector, the rational Gram matrix certifying the witness, and a standalone script that re-verifies Theorem 1 in exact arithmetic using only the Python standard library
summary: The numerical bootstrap for quantum mechanics tests a candidate state's positivity only against sums of squares, whereas every physical state assigns nonnegative expectation to every pointwise nonnegative polynomial. In one dimension the two coincide; in two or more they do not. Whether this gap is realized depends sharply on which constraint set is imposed. For the stationary bootstrap, which imposes <[H,O]> = 0 and is the relaxation appropriate to thermal and mixed states, we exhibit a two-dimensional quartic double well and a moment vector that satisfies every level-three stationary constraint exactly, has a positive definite moment matrix, and yet assigns a negative expectation to a polynomial nonnegative on R^2; it is therefore the moment sequence of no state. All data are rational, and every step is verified in exact arithmetic. For the eigenstate bootstrap, which additionally imposes <OH> = E<O>, the same search finds no violation in any of five settings spanning two, three and five degrees of freedom and truncation levels three and four, tested against complete families of separating polynomials. The single exception occurs at a truncation so low that only one eigenstate constraint survives, and the theory presented here accounts for it. We identify the mechanism: the eigenstate constraints bound the high momentum moments, otherwise unbounded on the feasible set, and it is those unbounded directions that reach the region between the two cones. Finally, under the reflection symmetries of a typical potential the relevant obstruction is copositivity rather than nonnegativity, which, for the quartic witnesses available at the lowest truncation, places the first possible failure at five degrees of freedom. We conjecture that the eigenstate constraints imply an Archimedean-type bound on the momentum moments, and formulate the corresponding tightness statement.

title: YOLO-PEFT: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning on YOLO Family
summary: Generic parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods transferred from language models can fail silently on real-time detectors, whose heterogeneous operators and detection-specific components impose placement constraints absent from regular Transformer stacks. We propose YOLO-PEFT, a structure-aware framework that formulates adapter placement as an auditable constraint-planning problem. Given a detector graph, a PEFT request, and a resource budget, YOLO-PEFT assigns operator and semantic roles, evaluates explicit operator-validity, detector-semantic, graph-interface, and deployment predicates, records a reason code for each excluded module, and either emits a budgeted target-module plan or returns Refuse before training. Under the official VOC07+12 trainval-to-VOC07 test protocol, planner-selected RS-LoRA reaches 0.7138 and 0.7307 mAP50-95 on YOLO11s and YOLO12s, respectively, compared with 0.6428 and 0.6662 for Full-SFT. On RT-DETR-L, all seven evaluated LoRA-family configurations cross the predefined catastrophic threshold, supporting a calibrated Refuse-to-Full-SFT decision within the evaluated coverage. A controlled YOLO11 audit further shows that LoRA reduces peak training memory by 43.9 percent, although training takes 1.72 times longer. Within the evaluated detector families, placement policies, and calibration coverage, YOLO-PEFT replaces manual target-module trial and error with explicit, inspectable planning while preserving verified train-save-merge-export paths; refusal on unseen detector architectures remains an open validation problem. title: Unsupervised Adaptation of PDE Foundation Models
summary: Pretrained partial differential equation (PDE) foundation models can generalize across different equations, but adapting them to unseen PDE systems typically requires dense solution data, which is often expensive or unavailable. To address this limitation, we propose an unsupervised PDE-based finetuning framework that eliminates the need for ground-truth solutions. We first pretrain a neighborhood attention Transformer on diverse time-dependent PDEs spanning varying spatial scales, yielding transferable representations across heterogeneous equations. In the adaptation stage, we construct a physics-based objective using the PDE residual and boundary conditions, and finetune the model on unseen equations via low-rank adaptation (LoRA). To address the uneven learning across physical quantities in standard LoRA, we introduce NSLoRA, a Newton-Schulz orthogonalized variant that rebalances adaptation. Our method achieves performance comparable to supervised LoRA finetuning without requiring any ground-truth solutions, while consistently outperforming competitive neural operator baselines and recent PDE foundation models across heterogeneous PDE benchmarks spanning multiple spatial dimensions.

title: Teacher Retains Full Tokens, Student Merges Efficiently: TM20K for E-Commerce Sequence Modeling in Ad Recommendation
summary: Benefiting from ultra-long behavior sequence modeling, existing recommender systems bring users a better experience via simultaneously considering their long-term and short-term interests. Nevertheless, extended sequence lengths introduce substantial burdens on training efficiency and serving throughput. Prior approaches typically utilize search-based or cluster-based compression on ultra-long sequences at the cost of fine-grained information, or rely on various lightweight target attention structures incapable of sufficient sequential feature extraction. In this paper, we balance the effectiveness and efficiency for ultra-long sequence modeling via full transformer modeling accompanied with a two-stage knowledge distillation framework. First, both teacher and student models take the full attention mechanism rather than pure target-sequence attention for effective sequence scaling. For student models, we propose several simple yet well-motivated token merge approaches, significantly compressing the sequence length while maintaining an acceptable performance. Then, a one-time teacher is heavily trained with full sequence tokens, further boosting the performance of student models via knowledge distillation. The proposed paradigm named TM20K has been successfully deployed in ByteDance's e-commerce advertising recommender system that extends the e-commerce sequence length to 20K, delivering substantial improvements in key business metrics (e.g., ADSS +1.036\%) while keeping the training and serving cost nearly the same as the online state-of-the-art model (e.g., serving latency only +5.6\%).

AI.title_translation: 教师保留完整 Token，学生高效合并：用于广告推荐中电商序列建模的 TM20K
AI.tldr: TM20K 结合全注意力 Token 合并与两阶段知识蒸馏，成功在低延迟增加（仅 +5.6%）的前提下将电商行为序列扩展至 20K 并实现了显著的业务收益。
AI.motivation: 超长用户行为序列建模虽能兼顾长短期兴趣并提升体验，但巨大的序列长度带来了严重的训练效率和在线服务吞吐压力；现有的搜索/聚类压缩方法会损失细粒度信息，而轻量化目标注意力结构则缺乏足够的序列特征提取能力。
AI.method: 提出 TM20K 框架：1. 教师和学生模型均采用全注意力（Full Attention）机制而非简单的目标-序列注意力；2. 在学生模型中引入简单且动机明确的 Token 合并（Token Merge）方法，大幅压缩序列长度；3. 预先重度训练一个保留全量 Token 的教师模型，通过两阶段知识蒸馏提升学生模型的表现。
AI.result: TM20K 已成功部署于字节跳动电商广告推荐系统，将序列长度拓展至 20K。在保持训练和服务成本与原在线 SOTA 基本持平的前提下（服务延迟仅增加 5.6%），实现了核心业务指标的显著提升（如 ADSS 提升 1.036%）。
AI.conclusion: TM20K 框架成功在工业级广告推荐系统中实现了 20K 超长用户行为序列建模，打破了超长序列在训练和在线服务上的效率瓶颈，为超长序列推荐提供了一种高效且高性能的落地范式。
AI.translation: 受益于超长行为序列建模，现有的推荐系统能够同时考虑用户的长期和短期兴趣，从而为用户带来更好的体验。然而，扩展的序列长度给训练效率和服务吞吐量带来了巨大负担。现有方法通常在超长序列上使用基于搜索或基于聚类的压缩，代价是损失细粒度信息；或者依赖各种轻量级的目标注意力结构，但无法进行充分的序列特征提取。在本文中，我们通过全 Transformer 建模结合两阶段知识蒸馏框架，平衡了超长序列建模的有效性与效率。首先，教师模型和学生模型都采用全注意力机制，而非纯粹的目标-序列注意力，以实现有效的序列扩展。对于学生模型，我们提出了几种简单且动机充分的 Token 合并方法，在保持可接受性能的同时大幅压缩序列长度。然后，使用全序列 Token 重度训练一个一次性教师模型，进一步通过知识蒸馏提升学生模型的性能。所提出的名为 TM20K 的范式已成功部署在字节跳动的电商广告推荐系统中，将电商序列长度扩展至 20K，在带来核心业务指标显著提升（例如 ADSS +1.036%）的同时，保持训练和服务成本与在线 SOTA 模型几乎相同（例如服务延迟仅 +5.6%）。
AI.summary: 针对超长用户行为序列建模带来的计算与延迟瓶颈，本文提出 TM20K 框架。该框架结合全 Transformer 建模与两阶段知识蒸馏，利用教师模型保留全量 Token 进行深度表征，并在学生模型中引入高效的 Token 合并机制压缩序列。该方案已在字节跳动电商广告推荐系统中部署，成功支持 20K 长度序列，显著提升业务指标且仅带来极低的服务延迟增长。
AI.keywords: 超长序列建模, 令牌合并, 知识蒸馏, 广告推荐, 电商推荐系统
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将大模型中常用的 Token Merge（令牌合并）技术与知识蒸馏相结合，巧妙地解决了超长行为序列（20K）在广告推荐系统中高并发、低延迟要求的落地难题。通过让教师模型承担全量 Token 建模并通过蒸馏传递知识，学生模型在经过 Token 合并压缩后依然保持高精度，展现了极高的工业实用价值和效果效率平衡能力。

title: BONSAI: Evolvability-Guided Tree Search over Skills
summary: A skill is a naturallanguage document that steers a frozen agent whose weights cannot be updated so any capability the agent lacks must be supplied in prose Optimising a skill is therefore optimising text against a score and the standard recipe which keeps any edit that raises a heldout score is blind in a specific way a single score cannot tell a document perched on a narrow overfit spike from one resting on a broad plateau even though only the second can still be improved We introduce BONSAI a novel skilloptimisation framework that steers instead by evolvability the capacity of a region of documentspace to keep producing viable variation under further mutation a property biology treats as separate from present fitness BONSAI grows skills as a MonteCarlo search tree in which every child document is a mutation of its parent and descends it under an upperconfidence selection rule whose exploitation term blends a skills own fitness with the fitness of its mutational neighbourhood Because every child is a mutation the mean score recorded beneath a node estimates that neighbourhoods evolvability at no extra cost so the rule concentrates budget on regions that keep improving while its exploration term keeps a currently weak branch in contention BONSAI ships the single bestscoring document it finds at no cost beyond the acceptifbetter loop it replaces With a frozen 30B agent and averaged over three benchmarks BONSAI lifts heldout accuracy over the skillfree agent by 2313 points and improves on two budgetmatched baselines GEPA and SkillOpt by 387 and 397 points respectively

AI.title_translation: BONSAI：基于可演化性引导的技能树搜索
AI.tldr: BONSAI结合蒙特卡洛树搜索与生物学中的“可演化性”概念，通过评估突变邻域的潜力来优化冻结Agent的文本技能，显著超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 传统的文本技能优化方法通常仅根据分数增量保留修改，这种方式无法区分文档是处于狭窄的过拟合峰值还是处于具有广阔改进潜力的平原，容易陷入过拟合且无法持续优化。
AI.method: 提出了BONSAI框架，将技能优化建模为蒙特卡洛搜索树（MCTS）。树中的每个子文档都是父文档的突变，通过上置信度（UCB）选择规则扩展。该规则的利用项融合了技能自身的适应度与突变邻域的平均适应度（以此无成本估计可演化性），探索项保持潜在分支的竞争力，从而将资源集中在持续可改进的区域。
AI.result: 在使用30B参数冻结Agent的三个基准测试平均结果中，BONSAI将未见数据的准确率比无技能Agent提升了23.13分，且在相同预算下优于GEPA（高3.87分）和SkillOpt（高3.97分）两个基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于可演化性引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索能够有效优化自然语言技能，避免落入过拟合陷阱，显著提升冻结Agent在未见任务上的性能。
AI.translation: 技能是一种自然语言文档，用于引导权重不可更新的冻结Agent，因此Agent缺乏的任何能力都必须通过文本提供。因此，优化技能就是针对分数优化文本，而保留任何能提高留出分数的修改的标准方法存在特定盲区：单一分数无法区分停留在狭窄过拟合峰值上的文档与停留在宽广高原上的文档，即便只有后者才能继续被改进。我们推出了BONSAI，这是一种全新的技能优化框架，它转而通过“可演化性”（即文档空间某个区域在进一步突变下持续产生可行变异的能力，生物学将其视为与当前适应度分开的属性）进行引导。BONSAI将技能作为蒙特卡洛搜索树增长，其中每个子文档都是其父文档的突变，并在上置信度选择规则下向下扩展，该规则的利用项融合了技能自身的适应度与其突变邻域的适应度。因为每个子节点都是一次突变，所以在某个节点下记录的平均分数无需额外成本即可估算该邻域的可演化性，因此该规则将预算集中在持续改进的区域，同时其探索项使当前较弱的分支保持竞争资格。BONSAI最终交付它所找到的得分最高的单一文档，除了替换了“若变好则接受”循环之外不产生额外成本。在冻结的30B Agent上并在三个基准测试中取平均，BONSAI将留出准确率比无技能Agent提高了23.13个百分点，并分别比两个预算匹配的基线GEPA和SkillOpt提高了3.87和3.97个百分点。
AI.summary: 针对冻结Agent的自然语言技能（Skill）文本优化容易陷入过拟合峰值的问题，本文提出了BONSAI框架。BONSAI引入生物学中的“可演化性”概念，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索在技能突变空间中探索，并在选择规则中融合个体适应度和突变邻域适应度，以零额外成本评估区域的演化潜力。实验表明，BONSAI在多个基准测试上显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.keywords: 技能优化, 蒙特卡洛树搜索, 可演化性, 冻结Agent, 提示工程
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将生物学中的“可演化性（Evolvability）”概念引入大模型Prompt/Skill自动优化领域，并与蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）巧妙结合。其最大的亮点在于利用树结构的突变关系，在不增加额外评价开销的前提下估算区域的演化潜力，有效避开了传统贪心搜索容易陷入狭窄过拟合局部最优的缺陷。局限性在于搜索树的构建依赖于有效的文本突变机制和评价函数的平滑性。

title: KnifeHunter: Structured Local Representation Learning for Fine-Grained Knife Image Retrieval in Law Enforcement
summary: Knife-enabled violence presents a major public safety challenge, and law enforcement agencies require scalable tools for catalogue-level knife identification, intelligence analysis, and source attribution. Manual visual comparison is specialist, time-consuming, and difficult to scale under operational imaging conditions. We introduce KnifeHunter, an end-to-end forensic knife image retrieval system developed with UK law enforcement. The work contributes the KnifeHunter dataset, comprising 25,843 images across 543 knife classes from police evidence, retail catalogues, and border-force seizures, with structured metadata, Medium/Hard evaluation protocols, and large-scale distractor evaluation. We further propose CoRe-Net, a compact single-descriptor retrieval architecture that combines global context with spatially localised discriminative evidence. CoRe-Net introduces Structured Complementary Representation Learning (SCRL) to organise local evidence into complementary prototype-based representations, and Bi-Directional Reciprocal Fusion (BDRF) to integrate global and local evidence through residual projection and gated local-to-global injection. Using an EVA02-Base backbone and cosine-similarity retrieval, CoRe-Net achieves 88.0% mAP and 86.7% mP@10 on the Medium protocol, and 85.1% mAP and 83.8% mP@10 under distractor conditions. KnifeHunter was deployed by UK police forces during Operation Sceptre deployments from 2023 to 2025, achieving 99.2% mP@1 on field queries. These results demonstrate a practical and effective multimedia retrieval framework for fine-grained forensic knife matching in operational law-enforcement settings.

AI.title_translation: KnifeHunter：面向执法部门细粒度刀具图像检索的结构化局部表征学习
AI.tldr: 本文推出了KnifeHunter系统和CoRe-Net架构，通过结构化局部表征学习实现高效精准的刀具细粒度图像检索，并在英国执法部门实战中取得极高准确率。
AI.motivation: 持刀暴力对公共安全构成了重大挑战，而执法部门缺乏可扩展的、用于目录级刀具识别、情报分析和来源归因的自动化工具，人工目视比对耗时且难以在实际复杂成像条件下扩展。
AI.method: 提出了CoRe-Net架构，采用EVA02-Base骨干网络和余弦相似度检索；包含结构化互补表征学习（SCRL）以组织局部证据，以及双向互惠融合（BDRF）以整合全局和局部证据。
AI.result: 在Medium评测协议下取得了88.0%的mAP和86.7%的mP@10，在干扰项条件下取得了85.1%的mAP和83.8%的mP@10；在英国警察局2023至2025年的实地查询中，达到了99.2%的mP@1准确率。
AI.conclusion: KnifeHunter和CoRe-Net为执法部门提供了一个高效、可扩展且具备极高实战价值的细粒度刀具图像检索框架。
AI.translation: 持刀暴力对公共安全构成了重大挑战，执法部门亟需可扩展的工具来进行目录级刀具识别、情报分析和来源归因。人工目视比对专业性强、耗时且在实际成像条件下难以扩展。我们推出了KnifeHunter，这是一个与英国执法部门共同开发的端到端法医刀具图像检索系统。本研究贡献了KnifeHunter数据集，包含来自警方证据、零售目录和边境查获的543个刀具类别的25,843张图像，并带有结构化元数据、中/难评估协议以及大规模干扰项评估。我们进一步提出了CoRe-Net，这是一种紧凑的单描述符检索架构，将全局上下文与空间局部的判别证据相结合。CoRe-Net引入了结构化互补表征学习（SCRL），将局部证据组织为基于原型的互补表征；并通过双向互惠融合（BDRF），通过残差投影和门控局部到全局注入来整合全局和局部证据。使用EVA02-Base骨干网络和余弦相似度检索，CoRe-Net在中等协议下实现了88.0%的mAP和86.7%的mP@10，在干扰项条件下实现了85.1%的mAP和83.8%的mP@10。KnifeHunter于2023年至2025年在英国警察局的“权杖行动”（Operation Sceptre）部署中使用，在实地查询中实现了99.2%的mP@1。这些结果证明了一个实用且高效的多媒体检索框架，适用于执法操作环境中的细粒度法医刀具匹配。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了KnifeHunter，一个与英国执法部门联合开发的端到端法医刀具图像检索系统，包含包含丰富类别与元数据的 KnifeHunter 数据集以及创新的 CoRe-Net 检索架构，在细粒度刀具检索和执法实战中表现出卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: 细粒度图像检索, 执法证据识别, 结构化局部表征学习, 刀具暴力防控, 深度度量学习
AI.comments: 该论文紧密结合英国执法部门的实际需求，提出了一种专门针对刀具细粒度检索的系统KnifeHunter及创新架构CoRe-Net。其最大亮点在于兼顾了学术创新（如SCRL和BDRF）与强大的实战部署能力（在Operation Sceptre中取得极高的首选准确率），为公共安全和司法鉴证提供了可扩展的自动化工具。

title: Automated vehicles: Challenging transition from Minimal Risk Condition
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible. Both authors contributed equally to this article. Corresponding author is Leon Johann Brettin
summary: If an automated vehicle is no longer capable of handling the dynamic driving tasks, regulations require that a minimal risk manouvre is initiated aimed at achieving minimum risk condition. Details on measures and actions to resolve this standstill position are missing. This article provides clues for closing this gap and addresses various states in which the human intervention operator must understand the current situation and decide whether it is more acceptable to maintain the stay, e.g. on road-shoulder, or to move the vehicle back into traffic flow or 'limp it' to another position, depending on the outcome of a health check. Our investigations, based on a list of nearly 30 reasons and a subsequent development of 'scenario trees' prove the complexity of the situation and the heavy difficulties faced by the operator to handle in a correct manner. We also discuss how the technical automated driving system can be enhanced so that it stronger supports the operator or allows to even dismiss human intervention. This deems technically feasible but limits became obvious, so that assistance from out side appears indispensable at least for the ramp-up phase of respective automated vehicle. The non-trivial problem of transitioning the 'stranded' vehicle needs to be addressed by further regulation for which this paper may provide useful input.
